title: Soundness of the Width-Three Tseitin Transformation
statement: Let $$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables, let $w$ be any natural number, and let $y$ be an assignment to the original and auxiliary variables, of total length $n+(w-3)||$. If the width-three Tseitin transformation evaluates to the satisfying sign at $y$, then $$ evaluates to the satisfying sign on the restriction of $y$ to the original variables.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula on n variables
